title: One Man Survived Both Atomic Bombs, Three Days Apart

scenes.text: One man survived both atomic bombs.
Tsutomu Yamaguchi was in Hiroshima on business on August 6th, 1945.
Injured, he got home to Nagasaki, his hometown.
Three days later, on August 9th, the second bomb fell on that city.
He survived again, and in 2009 Japan officially recognised him as a survivor of both.
He lived to be 93. Three days apart. Both times.

description:
Tsutomu Yamaguchi was in Hiroshima on August 6th, 1945, then returned home to Nagasaki, where the second bomb fell three days later.
In 2009 Japan officially recognised him as a survivor of both attacks. He died in 2010 aged 93.
What do you think we can learn from stories like his?
first_comment: He later campaigned for nuclear disarmament. What story from history do you think everyone should know?
